instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Independent power producer operating a portfolio of 12 solar photovoltaic plants and 3 onshore wind farms across Iberia with a combined capacity of 180 MW. Selling electricity through PPAs and spot market. Evaluating battery storage co-location and AI-driven production forecasting. A growing organization that has moved past founder-led decision-making but is still building the formal processes and governance structures needed to scale. We have some digital tools in place but integration between systems is ad-hoc. Innovation is championed by 1-2 internal advocates.
answers.pastInitiatives: We successfully deployed a new CRM system across the sales team 18 months ago, which improved lead tracking and reduced pipeline data entry time by 30%. The implementation was well-planned with dedicated project management and training. Building on this success, we are now exploring marketing automation integration and AI-assisted lead scoring.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business — we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing, not shrinking.
answers.teamSize: We have a small technology team of 8-6 people including developers, a part-time DevOps engineer, and a product manager who also handles project management. The team is fully allocated to maintaining current products and handling integration requests from key clients. Innovation work is done in the margins — there is no formally ring-fenced innovation time or budget.

input.changes_since_last: Supply chain disruptions affected 4 product lines. Inventory digitalization project launched. Margins under pressure.

opportunities.title: Integrated Operational Data Layer (Digital Twin Foundation)
opportunities.rationale: The successful launch of inventory digitalization and existing CRM maturity demonstrate the capability to connect disparate systems. This opportunity evolves these isolated digital projects into a unified data layer, providing real-time visibility needed for predictive maintenance and optimized resource allocation across all 15 facilities.

first_actions: Audit current API endpoints and identify necessary integration points between CRM, ERP, and the new Inventory System.
Develop a phased data governance model defining ownership and quality standards for key operational metrics (e.g., PPA pricing vs. spot market generation).
Pilot real-time data ingestion on one specific product line to validate latency and accuracy.
resources_needed: Executive sponsorship from Operations and IT Leads
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in time required to generate a consolidated operational performance report by 75%.
milestones: Successful end-to-end data flow pilot completion.
Adoption of standardized KPIs across departments.

opportunities.title: Adjacent Market Service Line (Energy Resilience Consulting)
opportunities.rationale: Due to structural decline in the core energy market, Helix must pivot beyond being a pure IPP. This opportunity leverages existing operational data and deep sector knowledge to offer consulting services—such as grid stability modeling or battery co-location optimization—to smaller utilities or commercial real estate developers. This creates a new revenue stream independent of traditional PPA cycles.

first_actions: Conduct internal capability assessment: Identify the specific technical IP (e.g., AI forecasting models, storage integration knowledge) that can be productized into service offerings.
Map 3-5 non-competing client archetypes that are currently struggling with energy resilience and could benefit from consulting services.
Develop a preliminary 'Statement of Work' template for a pilot advisory engagement.
resources_needed: Time allocation for technical staff (1-2 people, 25% time)
Executive buy-in to reposition the company narrative
execution_plan.success_metric: Securing one paid pilot advisory contract within 9 months.
milestones: Completion of first market validation workshops with potential clients.
Updated business plan incorporating consulting revenue modeling.

next_steps.action: Establish a dedicated Innovation Champion role (part-time or fractional) and ring-fence at least 4 days/month of 'Discovery Time' for the core tech team, focusing solely on opp_3 feasibility.
Conduct a 'Digital Readiness Workshop' involving key department heads (Sales, Operations, Finance) to prioritize pain points and confirm the minimum viable data requirements needed for opp_1.
Formalize a resource request to leadership demonstrating the potential revenue impact of opp_3, thereby building the business case for dedicated budget and time.

key_weaknesses: Critical resource bottleneck: Core technology staff are fully allocated to maintenance, preventing proactive innovation work.
Lack of organizational process formalization for strategic pivots; innovative efforts remain marginal/ad-hoc.
Strategic funding and time allocation model is insufficient to support high-impact radical change (opp_3).

improvements: Increased digital maturity level (from 3 to 4), confirming capability in system integration and data handling.
Successful process implementation via CRM deployment, providing internal evidence of operational improvement capacity.
persistent_gaps: The inability to scale innovation due to resource constraints remain the single biggest barrier.
Lack of a formal organizational mandate or dedicated budget for high-risk/high-reward strategic pivots (opp_3).
achieved_milestones: Inventory digitalization project is launched and operational.
Tech team has gained experience in cross-system data integration.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Improved digital maturity (3->4) and launched systems digitalization, showing increased technical capability. However, the underlying organizational constraint (resource allocation and process formalization for strategy) remains severe, necessitating a pivot toward radical diversification.
